stack: Next.js App Router, React, CSS Modules

decisions.scope: Christmas decoration behind the existing homepage introduction
interactions: Slow light shimmer and subtle tree movement
Pointer proximity lights up and gently displaces characters
Light ripple on background click or touch
constraints: Preserve existing copy, typography, logo, layout and booking links
Keep the native pointer and normal touch scrolling
Respect reduced motion; omit the visible pause control as requested by the user
Stop animation offscreen and in hidden tabs

decisions.direction: Albero ASCII a tutta altezza, leggibile su smartphone
decisions.scope: Enlarge the existing Christmas tree across the green introduction without changing the page layout
constraints: Larger, semibold light-gold glyphs with bright ivory ornaments and a subtle ornament glow
Keep a bright resting tree throughout the shimmer cycle
Soften only the tree close to text: 22% visibility behind text with an 18px transition; preserve the bright branches elsewhere, as requested by the user
Dim only the actual text lines, logo and language control, including interaction highlights
Passive touch trail must survive native scrolling and pointer cancellation
Preserve booking actions, native scrolling, reduced motion and bounded animation resources

decisions.direction: Albero ASCII verde molto scuro con decorazioni rosse e gialle
decisions.scope: Recolor the existing Christmas tree while preserving its full-height mobile layout
constraints: Use a tree green darker than the existing green page background
Scatter more red baubles and warm-yellow stars across the tree, keeping the existing red baubles in place
Preserve ornament colors during pointer and touch interactions
Keep the gold star and pointer trail
Preserve the existing local attenuation around text and native touch scrolling
Match the static fallback to the same dark-green, red and yellow palette
